LOAD_LATEST_SAVE.description: If true (default), the server loads the most recent save in /factorio/saves. Set to false to require an explicit SAVE_NAME.

SAVE_NAME.description: Specific save to load (without .zip). Empty = most recent save (when LOAD_LATEST_SAVE=true) or server refuses to start (when LOAD_LATEST_SAVE=false).

GENERATE_NEW_SAVE.description: If true, creates a new save named after SAVE_NAME on boot. Requires SAVE_NAME to be set. The new save persists in the volume.

UPDATE_MODS_ON_START.description: If true, runs docker-update-mods.sh on every boot to re-download mod versions listed in /factorio/mods/mod-list.json.
